classes.name: Sweep_NumShape
classes.summary: Gives a simple indexed representation of a Directing Edge topology.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (Index: number, Type: TopAbs_ShapeEnum, Closed?: boolean, BegInf?: boolean, EndInf?: boolean)
constructors.comment:
Creates a new simple indexed edge.
For an Edge : Index is the number of vertices (0, 1 or 2),Type is TopAbs_EDGE, Closed is true if it is a closed edge, BegInf is true if the Edge is infinite at the beginning, EndInf is true if the edge is infinite at the end.
For a Vertex : Index is the index of the vertex in the edge (1 or 2), Type is TopAbsVERTEX, all the other fields have no meanning.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (Index: number, Type: TopAbs_ShapeEnum, Closed?: boolean, BegInf?: boolean, EndInf?: boolean): void
instanceMethods.comment:
Reinitialize a simple indexed edge.
For an Edge : Index is the number of vertices (0, 1 or 2),Type is TopAbs_EDGE, Closed is true if it is a closed edge, BegInf is true if the Edge is infinite at the beginning, EndInf is true if the edge is infinite at the end.
For a Vertex : Index is the index of the vertex in the edge (1 or 2), Type is TopAbsVERTEX, Closed is true if it is the vertex of a closed edge, all the other fields have no meanning.

classes.name: Sweep_NumShapeIterator
classes.summary: This class provides iteration services required by the Swept Primitives for a Directing NumShape Line.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment: Reset the NumShapeIterator on sub-shapes of <aShape>.

instanceMethods.name: More
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if there is a current sub-shape.

instanceMethods.name: Orientation
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the orientation of the current sub-shape.

classes.name: Sweep_NumShapeTool
classes.summary: This class provides the indexation and type analysis services required by the NumShape Directing Shapes of Swept Primitives.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Create a new NumShapeTool with <aShape>. The Tool must prepare an indexation for all the subshapes of this shape.

instanceMethods.name: NbShapes
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of subshapes in the shape.

instanceMethods.name: Shape
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Shape at index anIndex.

instanceMethods.name: HasFirstVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if there is a First Vertex in the Shape.

instanceMethods.name: HasLastVertex
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if there is a Last Vertex in the Shape.
